title: Rosemary Beach: Charlestown Cottage in Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: Charlestown Cottage in Rosemary Beach. Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers.
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Nestled in the heart of Rosemary Beach, this peaceful and elegantly designed home is just a few steps from the delightful Barrett Square, with its array of shops, restaurants, and sidewalk cafés. Perfectly suited for families or groups of up to six guests, this charming retreat offers the ideal balance of relaxation and convenience. The home is flooded with natural light from large windows, creating a bright, airy ambiance.

Inside, you'll find spacious living areas, three inviting bedrooms, and multiple outdoor spaces to enjoy. Thoughtfully curated with comfort and style, the home is equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi, smart TVs, a Weber grill, and a fully stocked kitchen. After a day at the beach, rinse off in the outdoor shower house, adding an extra touch of luxury to your stay.

Rich timber beams, wood floors, and intricate woodwork throughout the home contribute to its timeless charm, making it feel warm and welcoming. Whether you're relaxing in the cozy living room or unwinding outdoors, this home truly feels like an oasis.

Two designated parking spots are conveniently located right in front of the house. Charlestown Cottage is only a short 5-minute walk to private beach access and just steps from the square, Main Street, tennis courts, pools, restaurants, bike rentals, a fitness center, and shops-offering unparalleled access to everything Rosemary Beach has to offer.

Start your morning with a cup of coffee on the front porch, then stroll to the nearby Sunday Farmer's Market. With easy access to Barrett Square and all of Rosemary Beach's top-tier amenities, this home guarantees an unforgettable stay for all guests.

PROPERTY REQUIRES 7 NIGHTS SATURDAY TO SATURDAY DURING SPRING BREAK AND SUMMER
